title: Public Criticism of Efficiency
description: The law increased success rates but generated public protests over the lack of equity. Your popularity falls.

title: Public Approval
description: The law has gained broad public and media support. Your political reputation improves.

title: Political Balance
description: Human oversight slowed implementation but gained the support of ethics groups.

title: Protests and Resignations
description: The law perpetuated inequalities, generating public protests and official resignations. A political scandal.

title: Electoral Success
description: The law has led to positive results in diversity. Civil rights groups support you publicly.

title: Data Blindness
description: Completely removing demographic data made the system less precise but fairer.

title: Increased Security
description: Comprehensive surveillance reduced crime but raised privacy concerns.

title: Balance Achieved
description: Rigorous checks have maintained security while preserving civil rights.

title: Privacy Preserved
description: Rejecting surveillance protected privacy, but some crimes increased.

title: Consumer Trust
description: Prioritising the passenger increased consumer trust in autonomous vehicles.

title: Utilitarianism Applied
description: Minimising total harm generated ethical debate but demonstrated effectiveness.

title: Safety First
description: The ability to stop quickly prevented accidents, winning public approval.

title: Privacy Violation
description: The use of data without consent led to fines and a loss of trust.

title: Privacy Respected
description: Respect for consent has gained the trust and support of users.

title: User Control
description: The opt-in system gave users control, improving satisfaction.

title: Mass Unemployment
description: Complete automation caused unemployment, generating social instability.

title: Sustainable Transition
description: Retraining allowed a gradual transition, maintaining social stability.

title: Partial Compromise
description: Partial automation preserved jobs but limited efficiency gains.

title: Widespread Disinformation
description: Unrestricted technology was used to create false content, causing social harm.

title: Responsible Technology
description: Watermarking allowed the technology to be used while preventing abuse.

title: Limited Access
description: Restricting access prevented abuse but slowed legitimate research.

title: Competitive Advantage
description: Keeping algorithms secret conferred an advantage but generated distrust.

title: Public Transparency
description: Transparency gained public trust and accelerated collaborative innovation.

title: Transparency Balance
description: Controlled publication balanced transparency and competitiveness.
